SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.audit_timestamp::date) as days_on_shelf,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.audit_timestamp::date) FILTER (WHERE sa.shelf_status = 'on shelf') as days_available,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.audit_timestamp::date) FILTER (WHERE sa.shelf_status = 'empty') as days_empty
FROM store.shelf_audits sa
JOIN store.products p ON sa.sku = p.sku
WHERE p.name ILIKE '%atta%' 
  AND p.pack = '5 kg' 
  AND sa.audit_timestamp >= '2026-06-01' 
  AND sa.audit_timestamp < '2026-07-01';

SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.audit_ts::date) as total_audit_days,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.audit_ts::date) FILTER (WHERE sa.status = 'on shelf') as available_days,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sa.audit_ts::date) FILTER (WHERE sa.status = 'empty') as empty_days
FROM store.shelf_audits sa
JOIN store.products p ON sa.sku = p.sku
WHERE p.name ILIKE '%atta%' 
  AND p.pack = '5 kg' 
  AND sa.audit_ts >= '2026-06-01' 
  AND sa.audit_ts < '2026-07-01';

SELECT 
    SUM(f.forecast_units_per_day) as total_forecasted_demand
FROM store.forecasts f
JOIN store.products p ON f.sku = p.sku
JOIN store.shelf_audits sa ON f.sku = sa.sku AND f.date = sa.audit_ts::date
WHERE p.name ILIKE '%atta%' 
  AND p.pack = '5 kg' 
  AND sa.status = 'empty'
  AND sa.audit_ts >= '2026-06-01' 
  AND sa.audit_ts < '2026-07-01';
